## Business agent and MCP infrastructure

A/1 Creative helps operating companies get ready for customers who use AI agents to search, compare, book, request quotes, or buy. The capability combines structured business identity and offers, a company-controlled business agent, secure MCP-connected tools, permissions, human approval, confirmation, and audit logs.

MCP is treated as an authorized tool connection layer. A/1 Creative does not claim that publishing an MCP server automatically makes a business discoverable to every consumer agent. Discovery and transactions depend on compatible platforms, trusted identity, current data, explicit permissions, and verified customer actions.

Current delivery status: pilot conversations are open. Production MCP tools, automated checkout, and agent-to-agent transactions are not represented as active until they are scoped, secured, and tested end to end.

## Purchase rules

- A/1 Creative services require scope confirmation and a written quote before work begins.
- A quote request is not a purchase and creates no payment obligation.
- Online checkout is not currently represented as active on this website.
- SMS consent is optional and is collected only through the unchecked checkbox on the quote page.
- A phone number alone is not SMS consent.
